summary: Skills collection bundling third-party scripts; no installer-attack behavior observed
details: Package ships a collection of 'skills' (bundled scripts and resources under bundled-skills/). Static pattern matches fire on various bundled resources: a Python scraper and API server using ping/HTTP (bundled-skills/junta-leiloeiros/scripts/), a benchmarks shell script (bundled-skills/loki-mode/benchmarks/run-benchmarks.sh) containing curl and install-related tokens, a rclone CLI installer wrapper (bundled-skills/rclone-cli/scripts/install.sh) that curls from rclone.org (the official rclone project domain), and a YouTube note-taker verify script using curl/GET. These scripts are bundled assets, not auto-executed by npm lifecycle hooks on install of this package. The curl targets observed point to official project domains (rclone.org) rather than anonymous or attacker-controlled hosts. No credential harvesting, environment scraping, hardcoded C2, obfuscated destinations, or install/import-time execution of fetched content against the installer was found. The bundled scripts run only when a user explicitly invokes the corresponding skill.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
